purpose: Test the predicted high-k transfer from MUSIC's repeated real-space restriction of zoom velocity fields onto the common L8 grid.

model.operation: three successive 2x2x2 cell averages, equivalent to an 8-child-cell box average per axis
model.power_prediction: parent-mode power weighted by the squared separable 3D transfer
model.code_path: lagMUSIC src/main.cc: coarsen_density(..., data_forIO, false); src/densities.cc: mg_straight().restrict; src/mg_operators.hh: eight-child arithmetic mean

limits: This is a diagnostic model of the restriction filter; extra fine-level modes can alias into the coarse field and leave residuals.
It does not validate absolute CAMB velocity normalization or fine-level modes L9-L11.
It is not a RAMSES evolution, QUMOND run, halo-resolution validation, or RAR measurement.
